q: we introduce PRDBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating repository-level code agents against Product Requirement Documents (PRDs)
r: Include: new project-level benchmark and judge from natural-language requirements, a contribution to the evaluation method.

r: Include: multi-file feature-level evolution from release-note specifications, explicitly not issue repair; new benchmark.

q: we have introduced WebCoderBench, a comprehensive benchmark consisting of 1,572 authentic user requirements and 24 evaluation metrics

r: Include: new benchmark of feature implementation tasks with controlled comparison of coding agents collaborating, a new comparison design.

r: Include: token-cost analysis of agents on 30 end-to-end development tasks; contribution is a cost metric analysis (EC6 ii); short paper is kept.

q: we introduced ProjDevBench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate coding agents in the context of end-to-end project development
r: Include: end-to-end project development from requirements with six agents compared, new benchmark.

q: We presented RepoMod-Bench, a benchmark for repository-level code modernization built on an implementation-agnostic evaluation paradigm
